title: QQ16: add an F0-B1 selected-state shear
body:
## New mechanism

This package tests the reversible selected-state shear

```text
X_T <- X_T + X_A
Y_T <- Y_T - X_A
```

between the fixed QQ16 F0 and B1 calls. It preserves each selected `X_T+Y_T` sum and uses existing fields. The exact source-pinned group-algebra replay propagates all eight directions of the retained selected-input erasure witness through B1. Without the shear the T output has rank 0; with it the T output has rank 8. The package includes a nonsingular exact 8-row minor with determinant `-1/4096` and its owner-map keys and rational coefficients.

This establishes a local interface mechanism for the fixed witness family. It does not establish that later events preserve these values, a complete controller, a supplier, or a new κ.

## Cost and validation

The shear adds 16 scalar additions per owner at the common `completed(0)` data frame. It uses no new helper, owner map, precision, temporary storage, or recursive child. It preserves selected sums and leaves the inherited helper-restoration contract unchanged.

Reproduce from the repository root:

```sh
python3 -I -B research/qq16-f0-b1-shear-seedccce426/verify.py
python3 scripts/research_package.py --check-only --package research/qq16-f0-b1-shear-seedccce426
```

Observed locally on CPython 3.14.7: `PASS_QQ16_F0_B1_IDENTITY_SHEAR_WITNESS`, rank 8 / zero-control rank 0, minor determinant `-1/4096`; package metadata and all 14 source pins pass. This machine has no local Python 3.12 executable; the registered package specifies normal and optimized 3.12 replays for hosted CI.

## Provenance

Base: `0fdd7d82de03e43c9e5a1000dfbcd380d1b687d2`; selected record SHA-256: `10b9e340fd8e354a37a0c4813c90e5de1dd42044b5f6aca4a3fc5a42b685fa32`.

Ali Romman and the retained joint-query lineage (PR #1969) supply the maps, routes, local words and erased-input witness. PR #2086 treats changed A logging while leaving the T output fixed; this contribution inserts an A-to-T shear between F0 and B1 without adding an ordinary query. Cinna Davis (PR #2079) and Adam Gall (PR #2093) supply adjacent observation analyses. Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no independent human review is claimed.
